newsitem.title: UK: Air transport groups back Manchester's 2nd runway.
newsitem.headline: Air transport groups back Manchester's 2nd runway.

text.p: Two leading international air transport organisations said they welcomed the approval given yesterday for Manchester airport's second runway, and said it would be beneficial to both the industry and the local economy.
International Air Transport Association (IATA) director general Pierre Jeanniot said "This is very good news -- and a result that this asssociation has worked to bring about for some time."
The second runway will enable Manchester:" to strengthen Northwest England's ties with Europe, North America and the Asia/Pacific region," and to meet forecast demand growth, he added.

Air Transport Action Group (ATAG) executive director John Meredith said the decision "reflects a recognition by the authorities that the economic benefits of the runway will far outweigh its environmental impact."
ATAG is an independent industry group set up in 1990 to help promote aviation industry infrastructure improvements worldwide and is based in Geneva.
